steps.note: Open the eRFX creation screen containing stage configuration.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Create an RFP-only event so the technical questionnaire is available.
Open the RFP stage where the template question is configured.
Apply the available RFP template that contains the existing question.

args.goal: On the RFP questionnaire screen, click the Edit icon for the existing question, change its question text to a new value, save it, and stop on the screen showing the updated question text.

steps.note: Perform and verify the question edit because no catalog domain step directly supports editing an existing technical question.
Assert the updated questionnaire screen has no application error or rendering failure.
